proposals.evidence: Turner records Gujarati nānũ/nāhnũ, Old Gujarati nānhūṁ, Oriya sāna and Marathi sāna/lahān small under ślakṣṇa. The western survey nān-/hān- forms with k/l diminutive extensions and the eastern san/nani forms fit this established small-size family; hān- reflects the regional s/h correspondence, while nasal or lateral suffixes are preserved. Forms with a medial d cluster are excluded from this rule.
